title: The Island of Liars

steps.prompt: In the haunted village, every resident is either a KNIGHT (always tells the truth) or a KNAVE (always lies). 4 residents speak. Work out who is who. Answer with the first letters of the names of all the KNIGHTS in alphabetical order, with no spaces (for example AC).
clues: Aldric says: "Exactly one of Fenella and Aldric is a knight."
Corvin says: "Exactly one of Hester and Aldric is a knight."
Hester says: "Fenella and Corvin are both knaves."

reveal_text: Among the bones a rib has a number scratched into it: 7.
